tools.name: snowluma_actions
tools.description: Look up SnowLuma OneBot actions. With no args it lists categories and enabled/disabled counts; query/category search the catalog; name returns one action's full docs and JSON Schema. Disabled actions are hidden unless include_disabled is true.

query.description: Search action name, alias or summary.

name.description: Return the full catalog entry and inputSchema for this action or alias.

category.description: Filter by catalog category, e.g. 消息 or 群管理.

include_disabled.description: Also list actions disabled by config. Default false.

summary.zh: 查 SnowLuma 的 OneBot action 目录、参数 Schema 和启用状态。
summary.en: Look up SnowLuma's OneBot action catalog, JSON Schemas and enabled state.

tools.name: snowluma_call
tools.description: Call any SnowLuma OneBot action. Read-only actions run immediately. Write actions require confirm=true and are refused when disabled by worlds.snowluma.actions.disabled. Use snowluma_actions first when you do not know the action name or params. The result is the OneBot response envelope.

action.description: Action name or alias, e.g. send_group_msg or get_group_info.

params.description: The action params object. For send_* actions, message may be a string or OneBot segment array.

confirm.description: Set true to execute a write action.

summary.zh: 调用任意 SnowLuma OneBot action；只读直接执行，写操作需要 confirm=true。
summary.en: Call any SnowLuma OneBot action; reads run immediately, writes need confirm=true.

tools.name: snowluma_events
tools.description: Read archived SnowLuma events by kind/time. Useful for events that were muted, arrived before the current turn, or are not delivered by policy. kind supports * (e.g. notice/*). raw defaults to true.

kind.description: Event kind or glob: message/group, notice/group_recall, meta_event/*.

raw.description: Include meta.raw. Default true; set false for a compact result.

summary.zh: 按类型和时间查已归档的 SnowLuma 事件。
summary.en: Read archived SnowLuma events by kind and time.

tools.name: snowluma_view_image
tools.description: Download an image and return it as an attachment the model can actually see. Use this when a message only shows [图片], or when you have an image URL / SnowLuma file_id from get_image or snowluma_events. Provide url, or file/file_id for a SnowLuma cached image.

file.description: A SnowLuma image file parameter (usually from an image segment).

summary.zh: 把图片 URL 或 SnowLuma 图片 file_id 下载成模型能看的附件。
summary.en: Download an image URL or SnowLuma image file_id as an attachment the model can see.

tools.name: snowluma_status
tools.description: SnowLuma connection, account, action catalog, and current action/event policy. Never returns the access token.

summary.zh: 看 SnowLuma 连接、账号、catalog 和当前策略状态。
summary.en: Show SnowLuma connection, account, catalog and current policy.

description.zh: SnowLuma 送来的一条 QQ 消息；正文是可读的一行，meta.raw 是原始 OneBot 事件。
description.en: A QQ message from SnowLuma; text is a readable line and meta.raw is the original OneBot event.

description.zh: 未专门投影的 OneBot 事件（notice/request/meta_event 等）；正文是一行摘要，meta.raw 是原始事件。
description.en: An OneBot event that is not specially projected (notice/request/meta_event, etc.); text is a compact line and meta.raw is the original event.

prompts.title: QQ（SnowLuma）

changelog.0.1.0:
- 首个版本：通过 OneBot v11 正向 WebSocket 接入 SnowLuma，覆盖全部 action 与 event。
- 一个通用 `snowluma_call` dispatcher，不按 action 建专用工具。发布包带本包维护的 OneBot v11 标准 action 兜底；完整 SnowLuma action 用 `npm run sync-catalog` 在本机同步，catalog 不进入 Git/npm。
- `snowluma_actions`：按关键词/分类查 action，给 `name` 返回完整 JSON Schema。
- `snowluma_events`：按 kind / 时间查归档的原始 OneBot 事件。
- `snowluma_view_image`：把图片 URL 或 SnowLuma 图片 `file_id` 下载成模型可看的附件。
- `snowluma_status`：连接、账号、catalog、action/event 策略。
- 默认全开，用 `actions.disabled` / `disabledCategories` / `events.mute` / `events.drop` 做配置减法；默认只禁用 `set_restart`、`clean_cache`、`bot_exit`。
- 写操作默认 `writePolicy: "confirm"`，需要 `confirm: true`；支持全局 `readOnly`。
- 消息里的图片会自动下载为 `blobs`；图片过大、URL 过期或下载失败时保留 `[图片]` 占位。
- 事件兜底：非消息 OneBot 事件统一为 `snowluma.event`，原始 JSON 保存在 `meta.raw`，没有 per-event handler。
- `delete_msg` 回执附带说明：`ok` 只代表撤回请求已发出，不代表 QQ 服务端已撤回。
- 需要扩展契约 world 6（Coopanion v0.2.0 / 内嵌 Cortico v0.2.0 及以上）。
